fields.value: Local neuroplasticity in adult glaucomatous visual cortex

dsDescriptionValue.value: This dataset contains ophthalmic data (visual acuity, IOP, VF sensitivity (measured using HFA and frequency doubling technology [FDT]) and macula nerve fiber layer (MNFL) thickness) and MRI (anatomical data and fMRI-retinotopic mapping). An indepth description of the dataset can be found here: https://www.biorxiv.org/content/10.1101/2022.07.04.498672v1

publicationCitation.value: Carvalho, J., Invernizzi, A., Martins, J., Renken, R. J., & Cornelissen, F. W. (2022). Local neuroplasticity in adult glaucomatous visual cortex. Scientific Reports, 12(1), [21981]. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41598-022-24709-1
